description: Bouncing-ball sequencer: eight columns, each with a ball that travels up and down its column one row per clock and fires a trigger at the end of its travel

inputs.text: A rising edge moves every ball one row; it reads high above 2V and low below 0.1V
A rising edge returns every ball to the bottom of its column

outputs.text: A 10ms 10V trigger from that column, fired as its ball turns around

notes: drag in the grid to set how tall each column is, which sets how many clocks that column's ball takes to come back round
every column starts one row tall, and a column one row tall fires nothing, so no trigger is put out until the grid is drawn
menu: Column Settings — All Columns and Column #1 through Column #8, each holding that column's Trigger Location
Trigger Location — Bottom, Top or Both, choosing which end of the column fires that column's trigger; reached through Column Settings

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
